<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/insurant-recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Request for payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ForwardedCase" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Insurer" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Request for payment" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDisagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ForwardedCase" name="Forwarded case" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency" messageRef="Message_ForwardedCase"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle possible recourse" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InformationReceived" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Possibility</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_NotPossible">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Possibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send request for payment" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for payment, disagreement, or deadline" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive money" messageRef="Message_Payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Booking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Booking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDisagreement" name="Receive disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reasoning_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" name="Is the insurant right?" default="Flow_ReasoningWrong">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reasoning_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementDeadline" name="Deadline for disagreement reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" name="Has money been received?" default="Flow_Deadline_NoMoney">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_NoMoney</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge" name="Merge case-closing outcomes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseMerge_Close</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseMerge_Close</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Message_ForwardedCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_NoMoney</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_InformationReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Possibility" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Possible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>recoursePossible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPossible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDisagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Booking" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePayment" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDisagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Result" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningRight" name="Right" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>insurantIsRight</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningWrong" name="Wrong" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>moneyReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_NoMoney" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseMerge_Close" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseForwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseMerge_Close</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseMerge_Close</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge" name="Merge forwarding paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_NoMoney</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForwardMerge_Forward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward case to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForwardMerge_Forward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_InformationReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Possibility" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Possible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recoursePossible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPossible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not recoursePossible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_BookingMerge" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Gateway_BookingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_BookingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moneyReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_NoMoney" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not moneyReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BookingMerge_Booking" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingMerge" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Result" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_InsurantRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningRight" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insurantIsRight</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningWrong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not insurantIsRight</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseMerge_Close" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardMerge_Forward" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseForwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/insurant-recourse">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Narrator" name="I" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle possible recourse" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InformationReceived" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Possibility</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Possibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send request for payment to insurant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for payment, disagreement, or deadline" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Money received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_BookingMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DisagreementReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementDeadline" name="Deadline for disagreement reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" name="Has money been received by the deadline?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_NoMoney</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BookingMerge" name="Merge money-received paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_BookingMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BookingMerge_Booking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BookingMerge_Booking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reasoning_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurantReasoningCorrect" name="Is the insurant's reasoning correct?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reasoning_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge" name="Merge case-closing paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseMerge_Close</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseMerge_Close</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge" name="Merge forwarding paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_NoMoney</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForwardMerge_Forward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward case to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForwardMerge_Forward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_InformationReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Possibility" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Possible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recoursePossible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPossible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not recoursePossible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_BookingMerge" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Gateway_BookingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_CheckMoney" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_MoneyReceived" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_BookingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moneyReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_NoMoney" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoneyReceivedByDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not moneyReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BookingMerge_Booking" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingMerge" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Result" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_InsurantReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningRight" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insurantIsRight</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningWrong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not insurantIsRight</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseMerge_Close" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseCaseMerge" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardMerge_Forward" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseForwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description specifies what activity or process end follows an activity, a decision outcome, or a catching event, or describes waiting for alternative events: Model each described transition with a sequence flow to its stated next activity or process end. For an event-based gateway, connect each branch first to the corresponding catching event, then continue that path to its described follow-up.
rules.situation: the description specifies what activity or process end follows an activity, a decision outcome, or a catching event, or describes waiting for alternative events

rules.instruction: When the description presents a decision whose outcome depends on a stated condition: Label the gateway with a concise question that names the stated condition, rather than a vague confirmation prompt.
rules.situation: the description presents a decision whose outcome depends on a stated condition

rules.instruction: When the description mentions sending information to, or receiving a response, payment, or other input from, an external party but describes no process work performed by that party: Model the described work and any necessary communication or waiting within the in-scope process; do not add a separate participant pool or message flows solely because the external party is mentioned.
rules.situation: the description mentions sending information to, or receiving a response, payment, or other input from, an external party but describes no process work performed by that party

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity, event, or decision outcome leads to a specific next action: connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows, including the stated successor of each branch
rules.situation: the description states that an activity, event, or decision outcome leads to a specific next action

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome with an identifiable action or meaning

rules.instruction: When the description narrates work in the first person but does not explicitly name the narrator’s role: Represent the narrator who performs that work as a participant pool in the BPMN collaboration, with the narrated activities in that participant’s process.
rules.situation: the description narrates work in the first person but does not explicitly name the narrator’s role

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, event, or outcome with a specific action, object, recipient, or meaning
